lines: Cyrus Jamshed Guzder is an Investor Selling Shareholder selling up to 132,000 shares in the offer for sale, with proceeds up to ₹17.85 crore if all offered shares are sold (estimate; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower).
Estimated gain is up to ₹13.36 crore before offer expenses and taxes, if all offered shares are sold.
The money is already in hand since listing (trading started March 11, 2026), so the call is timely now for a conversation about what comes next.
Confidence is medium: the name is verified in the seller table, but holdings appear in only one section (promoter_holding).
